founder_decision.reason: Hotel Louisville Downtown operates a genuine transient hotel product available to the general public. Ordinary travelers may book rooms through the hotel's own booking flow / Expedia. Standard hotel room types and normal hotel check-in/check-out apply. No social-service, medical, residency, or program qualification is required for public hotel guests. The building's dual use as a Wayside Christian Mission transitional/social-service campus is material and remains documented, but it does not eliminate the separately operated public hotel inventory.

source_wording.wording: Type of Space: hotel. Number of Rooms: 15. Number of Suites: 2. Located in the heart of downtown Louisville's business and hospital district, Hotel Louisville offers the convenience and comforts of a quality downtown hotel at prices you might expect from one of the stripped down budget chains.
Hospital Hospitality House of Louisville is listed at the same 120 West Broadway address.

operates_as_conventional_transient_lodgi: UNCLEAR. Official municipal/downtown listing calls it a hotel with 15 rooms and 2 suites. The same campus is the Hospital Hospitality House / Wayside-associated lodging used by hospital families. It is not a standard branded transient hotel.
why_questionable: Current category is conventional hotels, motels, extended-stay, inns, and airport/convention lodging. A 17-key social-enterprise / hospital-family house that is also marketed as a downtown hotel sits between conventional lodging and a non-commercial hospitality house. Columbus treated similar B&B/guesthouse identities as OUT_OF_CURRENT_CATEGORY.
